description: [Residential] Rename a saved list, change how often its IPs rotate, or delete it. Deleting a generated list (id starts with g-) removes the saved entry only; credentials already exported keep working. Deleting other lists revokes their list connections. The response states whether connections were revoked.

rotation.description: For rotate: -1 keeps each IP while the device is online, 0 rotates on every request, a positive number rotates after that many seconds.
